content.text: {"answer":"The commit doesn't record an incident or specific triggering event — only a design rationale in a code comment. In packages/control-plane/src/fly.js the comment states the org admin token (env.FLY_API_TOKEN) 'never leaves this process' and that 'the CLI only ever receives 1h app-scoped deploy tokens' (lines 1-2). The mintDeployToken function backs this by minting a Fly limited-access token scoped to a single app_id with a 1-hour expiry (lines 48-56), while the CLI's fly.js only ever consumes a token passed in via env (packages/cli/lib/fly.js lines 12-13), never the org-wide credential itself. So the recorded intent is to minimize blast radius by never handing the CLI a broad, long-lived org credential — but no specific problem (e.g., a leak, breach, or misuse event) is documented as the trigger.
